verdict.rationale: The docs show API-driven money movement out of financial accounts via OutboundPayment objects (push transfers), plus ReceivedDebit objects for third-party debits, Transaction ledger objects, and a transaction.created webhook event. The fraud guide also mentions inbound transfers and returns as controllable flows. None of the evidence explicitly names ACH as the rail or shows originating ACH debits, and the only push example given is between financial accounts. missing for 10: explicit ACH credit and debit origination, same-day ACH windows, first-class return/NOC/reversal objects, webhooks specific to those unhappy paths, independent hands-on corroboration.
